claims.text: Many reviewers report the cream effectively relieves pain from arthritis, joint, and soft-tissue issues, though some note it reduces rather than eliminates pain.
Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant lavender scent and easy, non-greasy application compared to other DMSO products.
Several reviewers mention being initially scared or hesitant due to the label's warnings and 'solvent' small print.
Some reviewers advise applying sparingly or in moderation, especially on first use.
Multiple reviewers say they would purchase again or already buy it repeatedly.

qa.q: Does this cream have a strong smell?
qa.answer: No, reviews describe the smell as pleasant rather than strong: one says it has a pleasant smell with no foul odor [2], another notes no offensive odor [3], and others call it great-smelling or a nice lavender scent [4][6].

claims.text: The cream has a pleasant smell with no foul odor.
It smells great and has a nice lavender scent.

qa.q: Is it safe to use on sensitive skin?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: How quickly does it absorb without feeling greasy?
qa.answer: One reviewer says it absorbs well and is not sticky [2], and another says it does not seem greasy [1]. However, no review specifies how quickly it absorbs.

claims.text: It absorbs well and is not sticky.

qa.q: Can I use this on my face or only my body?
qa.answer: One reviewer reports using it on their face, saying it cleared up small red/brown spots caused by the sun [1]. However, no review explicitly states it is only for the body, so the reviews do not establish a body-only restriction.

claims.text: A reviewer used it on their face and it cleared up small red/brown spots caused by the sun.
No review states the product is only for the body.

qa.q: Is the DMSO concentration strong enough to actually work?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.
